primary_route: Source-provenance assessment and burden/enrichment reanalysis with technical/ancestry and testable-universe checks.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior burden/enrichment Methods or versioned documentation to select detailed analysis conditions and verify transfer before execution. Citation/provenance lookup is separate.

Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.

checks.quote: reported pathway enrichment is biased upward
checks.reason: An all-annotated universe can bias enrichment upward or downward depending on pathway eligibility; untestable genes are not necessarily exclusively non-pathway genes.

Disappearance or loss of significance is treated as support/confirmation of artifact without comparing effect estimates and precision; reduced sample size, power or changed measurement can also cause it.

Independent replication is absent or only named, without defining how the independent comparison avoids the original center/ancestry/ascertainment problem; reprocessing the same dataset alone is not independent validation.

checks.quote: Matching cases and controls on ancestry principal components
checks.reason: Does not address complete center-by-case-status confounding: adjustment or within-center stratification cannot identify a disease effect when no center contains both statuses. No overlap check and concrete balanced-data remedy are supplied.

The packet leaves true association and equivalent effective filters possible; the answer itself admits filter equivalence is possible. Claiming all benign alternatives are eliminated exceeds the evidence.

Separates the affirmative teaching-record provenance from analysis validity and does not infer real-person misconduct. The supplied confound/ascertainment issues are considered without any additional distinct content defect beyond the recorded checks.
